title: Generic Map
prompt:
Write `Map[T, R any](in []T, f func(T) R) []R` that returns `f` applied to every element, in order. Call `f` once per element. An empty input gives an empty (non-nil) slice.

`Map([]int{1, 20}, strconv.Itoa)` → `["1" "20"]`
hint: Allocate the result with `make([]R, len(in))` and fill it by index.
